question: Can outcome-free robust encodings recover development signal for T0/T1 after semantic clusters failed?
primary_change: Add train-only missingness patterns, categorical frequency encodings, quantile bins, inventory-relative ratios and preferred-geo centroid distances.
population: E030 train split only; E030 validation/test are not used.

validation.strategy: 3 expanding rolling lead-cohort folds inside E030 train
validation.selection: Compare atomic, missingness_frequency, robust_bins, geo_inventory_relative and combined_v2.
validation.promotion: Development challenger only; no production/recovery claim without new independent cohort.

items: All encoders fit on each fold training slice only.
Quantile edges are fit on past fold only.
Inventory reference statistics use fold-train rows only and no outcome.
Geo centroids use fold-train Spot coordinates only.
No E030 val/test, raw clocks, Availability LeadQuality, broker outcomes or current-state Spot aggregates.
